ns2:section.sectionText: TOPIC: Town & Gown in the 14th Century This course will explore music and music-making in medieval university towns in France and Italy, focusing on the innovations associated with the Ars Nova. Though the primary focus will be on the fourteenth century and the music of composers such as Guillaume de Machaut and Philippe de Vitry, attention will also be given to thirteenth-century Paris as a center of musical and scholastic learning, as well as the diffusion of ideas from university centers to cities across Europe. Prior experience with medieval music through a course such as MUS 313 or a course elsewhere in medieval studies is desirable.
